title: Raincheck: Deferred Multimodal Prefill for Efficient Multi-Turn MLLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.39562v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-turn conversations with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reuse input context, but long multimodal inputs increase time to first token (TTFT). Query-aware hard pruning reduces prefill tokens but permanently excludes information that later questions may require. We propose Raincheck, a framework for deferred multimodal prefill that decouples initial token selection from later information availability. An existing pruning method selects tokens for initial prefill; Raincheck preserves and progressively prefills unselected tokens in source order using unused compute capacity during decode. Unfinished prefill continues after answer return during available scheduling gaps. Attention visibility control and affine state mapping enable context updates after generation begins in full-attention and hybrid recurrent models. translated_title: Raincheck：面向高效多轮MLLM推理的延迟多模态预填充
translated_abstract: 与多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的多轮对话需要复用输入上下文，但冗长的多模态输入会增加首词生成时间（TTFT）。查询感知的硬剪枝可以减少预填充token数量，却会永久排除后续问题可能需要的信息。我们提出Raincheck，一个延迟多模态预填充框架，将初始token选择与后续信息的可用性解耦。由现有剪枝方法为初始预填充选择token；Raincheck则保留未选中的token，并利用解码过程中的空闲计算能力，按源文本顺序逐步对其进行预填充。在答案返回后，未完成的预填充会在可用的调度间隙中继续进行。通过注意力可见性控制和仿射状态映射，全注意力模型和混合循环模型在生成开始后仍可实现上下文更新。预填充-解码融合则减少了重复的权重读取。我们在Qwen3-VL-8B和Qwen3.5-9B上以30%初始多模态……（评估）
tldr: Raincheck提出延迟多模态预填充框架，先仅预填充少量关键token以降低首词延迟，再利用解码期间的空闲算力按序逐步补全其余多模态信息，在多轮对话中兼顾推理效率与信息完整性。
en_tdlr: Raincheck is a deferred multimodal prefill framework that prefills only a small set of key tokens to reduce TTFT, then progressively prefills the remaining multimodal tokens using idle compute during decoding, balancing efficiency and information completeness in multi-turn MLLM inference.
